# schemaregistry_schema (List Resource)

Lists the subjects registered in the Schema Registry, one `schemaregistry_schema` per subject. Use with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later).

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "schemaregistry_schema" "example" {
  provider = schemaregistry

  config {
    prefix = "orders-"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `prefix` (String) Only list subjects whose name starts with this prefix.
